lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Grid-like arrangement of high-luminance circular clusters posterior to the gills, forming at least five visible horizontal rows.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical high-intensity bands intersecting with horizontal lines of blobs, creating distinct anchor nodes in a rectangular pattern.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three parallel horizontal features on the upper flank characterized by a sharp luminance gradient transition from light (dorsal) to shadow (ventral).

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Low-density distribution of distinct circular high-luminance pixels within the boundaries of the first dorsal fin.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: The trailing edge of the first dorsal fin exhibits a non-uniform, jagged silhouette indicative of tissue loss or scarring.
other_distinctive_markers: Densely packed cluster of small high-luminance points on the dorsal surface of the visible pectoral fin.
